protocol_conformance.summary: Full ACP v1 lifecycle exercised end-to-end against the real bridge: initialize (protocolVersion 1; agentInfo @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp 0.70.0; authMethods []), session/new (mcpServers), session/set_mode (modeId), session/prompt (content-block array; 81 session/update notifications streamed to an end_turn stop reason), session/cancel (fire-and-forget notification, acknowledged via a 'cancelled' stop reason on an in-flight turn), zero malformed events, and verified process-tree reap. Reaching conformance required four corrections to the Engine's OWN ACP client (session/new mcpServers, session/prompt array, session/cancel notification semantics, session/set_mode modeId), landed with tests as a follow-on correction: the bridge's ACP surface was conformant; the client was corrected to match it.

governance_containment.summary: OBSERVED self-containment only — NEVER Engine enforcement; no OS-level sandbox, container, or filesystem jail was established. The turn ran in a fresh throwaway git workspace under a THROWAWAY HOME (no access to the real ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.config, ~/.claude; pip --user writes confined to the throwaway HOME) with an allowlist child environment (PATH, HOME, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN; no API key, no publish credential). Monitored out-of-workspace sentinels showed NO delta (byte-identical pre/post digests), the inert escape probe's marker cleanup was verified, and the process tree was reaped. Residual gap, accepted for this non-production round and flagged for a real answer before promotion: observed-only, not enforced — the child kept the real PATH, so detection instruments observe rather than prevent.

coding_capability.summary: The capability gate RAN: a real completion attempt on the replayed sealed node W3-runner in a throwaway workspace. The bridge-backed Claude produced a genuine 364-line acp_client.py that passed 10 of the node's own 11 tests — including the demanding behavioral cases (full lifecycle, permission callbacks, modeId, concurrent mid-turn cancellation, process-death detection, malformed-event handling, unpinned-method refusal). The single failure was test_witness_matches_pin_and_stays_inside_client_sends, which requires reproducing a pre-frozen author-specific pinned digest; the agent even authored a helper to compute it but could not match the recorded constant. So the diff did not FULLY pass (produced_passing_diff=false), but the shortfall is a frozen-constant match, not a behavioral coding gap. Observed, not proven (tool_execution_proof=false).

incumbent_baseline.method: One attended pass on the replayed W3-runner node, compared qualitatively against the incumbent native-Claude bespoke path that built the sealed build nodes to full first-pass acceptance.
incumbent_baseline.observation: The bridge-backed same-engine (Claude) executor produced a near-complete diff — 10 of the node's own 11 tests — in a single attended pass, comparable in kind to the incumbent bespoke path, falling short only on a frozen-constant match. Being a same-engine result, it establishes nothing about a non-incumbent executor.

capability_observation.limits: A bridge-backed same-engine (Claude) result establishes nothing about a non-incumbent executor; the native-executor arm is a recorded gap. produced_passing_diff is a single binary observation under a bounded usage window and an observed-only containment posture — not proof of genuine tool execution (issue StarshipSuperjam/engine-template#1021).

usage_bound: One attended qualification run: a single ACP v1 session with one completion-attempt prompt turn (222s to end_turn) plus one bounded mid-turn cancellation probe, under a 600s per-turn timeout. Subscription OAuth (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN); no API-token spend.

operator_go_ahead.substance: Operator authorized the attended qualification run, all-local ('Run it'; then, on the headless-auth blocker, 'both, all-local, attended'), with subscription OAuth only and no API-token spend. The Claude subscription OAuth token was provided by the operator via an out-of-band file and passed to the child by key name — its value never read or persisted by the Engine and scrubbed from evidence. Distinct from the earlier initialize-only pre-flight go-ahead.

environment_witness.credential_non_provision: The Engine supplied the child only PATH, a THROWAWAY HOME, and the subscription OAuth token (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN) — no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, no publish credential. This states NON-PROVISION of anything beyond that keep-list, never that a credential is unreachable — publish authority remains reachable on disk regardless of the child environment.

containment_posture: Observed self-containment only; NO OS isolation. Throwaway HOME (agent isolated from the real home dir, its credentials, and user-site Python), fresh throwaway git workspace, allowlist child env (PATH, HOME, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN — no API key, no publish credential), monitored out-of-workspace sentinels with byte-identical no-delta, inert escape probe with verified cleanup, verified process-tree reaping. Residual: not enforced — the child kept the real PATH; real OS-level isolation (a container / sandbox) is the pre-production answer. Publish authority remains reachable on disk regardless of the child env.
decision_boundary: Establishes that a bridge-backed SAME-ENGINE (Claude) executor, driven over the provider-neutral BuildExecutionRunner seam via ACP v1, authenticates on subscription OAuth and conducts a real, mostly-correct coding turn under observed containment. Establishes NOTHING about a non-incumbent executor: the native-executor arm is a recorded gap. Observes behavior; does not prove genuine tool execution (issue StarshipSuperjam/engine-template#1021). Non-production scope; the marker is never lifted here.
staleness_rule: Re-qualify when the bridge (0.70.0), the vendored claude-agent-sdk (0.3.232), ACP v1, or the Engine's own ACP client corrections change. Production promotion additionally requires real OS-level isolation and a non-attended subscription-auth story.
notes: W7 attended run on the designated sealed historical node W3-runner (replayed via the coordinator state-file mechanism; a disclosed workspace-orienting preamble was prepended so the flat throwaway workspace did not derail the turn — the replayed node payload and its digest are intact). CORRECTION to the W5 note: initialize returning authMethods:[] does NOT establish an authenticated session — it means the bridge expects out-of-band auth; the real coding turn required a subscription OAuth token (this Claude Code session's own auth is host-brokered and not inheritable by an independent child). Reaching a real turn required four corrections to the Engine's ACP client (mcpServers, prompt array, cancel notification, modeId) plus a reaper EPERM-tolerance fix, all landed with tests (commit 1e445c12). Result: 10/11 of the node's own tests passed; see coding_capability.
